mapper.select: select count(*) as totalTxns, sum(case when coalesce(trim(t.consume_code), '') = '' and coalesce(trim(t.consume_name), '') = '' then 1 else 0 end) as unclassifiedTxns, round(sum(case when coalesce(trim(t.consume_code), '') = '' and coalesce(trim(t.consume_name), '') = '' then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*), 0) * 100, 2) as unclassifiedPct, round(sum(case when coalesce(trim(t.consume_code), '') = '' and coalesce(trim(t.consume_name), '') = '' then abs(coalesce(t.balance_money, 0) + coalesce(t.income_money, 0)) else 0 end), 2) as unclassifiedAmount from `transaction` t where (t.deleted is null or t.deleted = 0)

select count(*) from `transaction` t left join cls_category c on c.code = t.consume_code where (t.deleted is null or t.deleted = 0) and coalesce(trim(t.consume_code), '') <> '' and (c.id is null or coalesce(c.deleted, 0) = 1)
select count(*) from v_transaction_analytics v inner join `transaction` t on t.id = v.id where v.is_refund = 1

select count(*) as totalRows, sum(case when coalesce(trim(v.merchant_token), '') <> '' then 1 else 0 end) as withToken, round(sum(case when coalesce(trim(v.merchant_token), '') <> '' then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(*), 0) * 100, 2) as tokenCoveragePct from v_transaction_analytics v inner join `transaction` t on t.id = v.id where v.is_transfer = 0
